summary: Current source makes native textareas auto-grow by default and adds complete declarative modal, image-lightbox and anchored-help examples with inherited effects after the published 2.0.0 release. Scrollable overlays and desktop app-shell sidebars also reserve stable classic-scrollbar space. Browser/device and final release validation are deferred by maintainer instruction until the planned 2.0.1 review. Published 2.0.0 downloads remain unchanged; source builds do not inherit their acceptance.
